 Who is Kym Johnson? Meet the 'Dancing with the Stars' Dedication Night guest judge who married 'Shark Tank' star Robert Herjavec
 She won mirrorballs with Donny Osmond and Hines Ward. She fell in love with her dance partner on Season 20. Last year, she had fans begging for a permanent chair after last year's Dedication Night
 Robin Raven   Creator • Follow Updated Oct 20, 2026 Updated Tue, October 20, 2026 at 9:13 PM UTC 5 min read Two-time “Dancing with the Stars” champion Kym Johnson returns as guest judge for Dedication Night on Tuesday, October 20. (Disney/Vince Valitutti) On tonight's Dedication Night on Dancing with the Stars , fans are sure to recognize the guest star in the fourth chair at the judges' table. She's got more ballroom history than nearly anyone else in the room. Kym Johnson, who now goes by Kym Johnson-Herjavec, lit up the dance floor as a pro dancer on 15 seasons as a Dancing with the Stars . She won the trophy twice yet ultimately left the show for love. Here's why fans are so excited about her return to the show.
 Why Kym Johnson is back at the judges' table
 Kym Johnson with fellow pro Mark Ballas. Johnson helped Mark and Shirley Ballas critique hopefuls on "Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro."
 (Disney/Vince Valitutti) Kym Johnson is returning for her second straight Dedication Night, after fans loved her take on last year's emotional episode. You can see her on the show Tuesday, October 20, at 8 p.m. ET on ABC and Disney+. Before last year's appearance, she told Us Weekly , "This show has been such an important part of my life, and returning to the ballroom always feels like coming home." She also appeared on the show's spin-off series, Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro , and she sat on panels at the show's first fan convention.
 Two mirrorballs and a record no other pro has matched
 Kym Johnson won her first American mirrorball with Donny Osmond in 2009, becoming the first pro to win in two countries.
 (Debby Wong / Shutterstock.com) Born in Sydney, Australia, Kym Johnson first appeared in the first three seasons of the Australian version of the show, then she became a pro dancer on the American version of Dancing with the Stars in 2006. She was first paired with talk show host Jerry Springer for debut in the third season.She earned her first Mirrorball trophy in 2009 with former teen idol Donny Osmond, which made her the first pro to win the title in two different countries. She did it again in 2011 with Pittsburgh Steelers star Hines Ward, according to ESPN .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kym Johnson was the runner up, coming in second place, with 'N Sync member Joey Fatone in 2007 and again with former professional football defensive tackle Warren Sapp in 2008. Other celeb partners she had on Dancing with the Stars over the years include David Arquette, Jaleel White, David Hasselhoff, Penn Jillette, and Mark Cuban.
 Johnson's last competitive season was Season 24 with Mr. T in 2017. She came back in 2023 for the tribute to the late Len Goodman, telling TV Insider , "It was really great being back in the ballroom." 
 The Season 20 partner who became her husband
 Shark Tank investor Robert Herjavec finished sixth with Kym Johnson on Season 20 of "Dancing with the Stars" and married her the following year.
 (Disney/Daniel Delgado Jr.) In 2015 Johnson was paired with Shark Tank investor Robert Herjavec. They finished sixth in Season 20, but hidden-camera rehearsal footage aired on the results show had already given the romance away. They got married in Los Angeles on July 31, 2016. According to UPI , Johnson walked down the aisle with her mom and dad as the song "Somewhere Over the Rainbow" from The Wizard of Oz played. She wore a strapless Monique Lhullier gown and carried a bouquet of white peonies.
 Weeks later, Johnson confirmed she wouldn't return as a pro. Herjavec was overjoyed as a newlywed. According to UPI, he said, "I enjoy every minute I spend with Kim. When I met her, I felt complete."
 Why fans begged for her to stay after last year's Dedication Night
 On October 14, 2025, Kym Johnson opened the night by telling the ballroom, "I know tonight means so much to everyone." Robert Irwin , the son of the late Steve Irwin, won extreme praise for his emotional performance that was dedicated to his mother, Kerri Irwin. Danielle Fishel dedicated her dance to her former Boy Meets World co-star William Daniels. He portrayed Mr. Feeny on the show and joined in via video to watch and talk to Fishel. Johnson treated everyone with such respect, and she gave generous advice and scores. 
 Advertisement Advertisement The Dedication Night episode drew 5.98 million viewers last year and viewers sent in a record 50.15 million votes, according to TheWrap , In a surprise twist, nobody went home. Carrie Ann Inaba commented on Johnson's Instagram, "You were brilliant tonight, Kym," and viewers flooded social media asking for a permanent fourth chair.
 Life after the ballroom: twins, Canada, Australia, and a Lifetime movie
 Kym Johnson was born in Sydney and now splits her time between Canada and Australia with husband Robert Herjavec and their twins.
 (Richie Chan / Shutterstock.com) Kym Johnson and Robert Herjavec welcomed twins Hudson and Haven in 2018. She told People , "I've got so much to thank Dancing with the Stars for," and she described a surprisingly ordinary routine that includes her Shark Tank husband riding the bus to school with the kids. The family splits its time between Canada and her native Australia. She also made her acting debut in the Lifetime movie, Hunting Housewives , alongside fellow Dancing with the Stars alums NeNe Leakes and Denise Richards.
 What her scores could mean on Tuesday
 Hosts Alfonso Ribeiro and Julianne Hough with the Season 35 cast of "Dancing with the Stars." Ten couples remain heading into Dedication Night.
 (Disney) With four judges, every routine is scored out of 40 instead of 30, and last year's Dedication Night high was a 36. With Jenna Dewan dancing alongside Alan Bersten and Julia Stiles honoring Heath Ledger, as I detailed in my Dedication Night preview , Kym Johnson could reshape the leaderboard for the night.
